items.title: How the US-Iran war has redrawn Asia's energy map
Turkey, Saudi, Pakistan: Attack on one nation deemed an attack on all
items.description: Pakistan, Turkey and Saudi Arabia have signed a mutual defence agreement, under which an armed attack on any one of the three countries will be treated as an attack on all. The pact comes as Saudi Arabia seeks to diversify its security partnerships after repeated attacks on its critical infrastructure amid the war in I…

items.title: How viable is the potential Iran-Oman Hormuz shipping deal?
items.description: Iran says a shipping accord with Oman is in its final stages, but analysts warn sanctions, security concerns and rival US-Iran goals could limit its impact.

items.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign joint defense pact
items.description: Amid a regional war between the US and Iran and Houthi attacks from Yemen, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan signed a joint defense accord, which claims to promote 'collective security' and 'peace, security and stability in the region.'

items.title: Russia drops record number of glide bombs on Ukraine as casualties pile up
items.description: Moscow's troops suffer high rate of losses as Zelenskyy renews air campaign against Russia.

items.title: Military Shake-Up Poses Little Threat to Ukraine’s Drone Revolution
items.description: From AI-powered combat robots to self-charging “mechanical birds,” Ukrainian engineers are rapidly reshaping the future of warfare. Despite political upheaval in Kyiv, drone developers and frontline troops say Ukraine’s defense-tech revolution has gained too much momentum to be reversed.

items.title: Besieged Sudanese city faces relentless drone strikes and risk of mass atrocities, U.N. warns
items.description: Hundreds of thousands of civilians in el-Obeid are being battered by relentless drone strikes and face critical water shortages and a worsening cholera outbreak, while women and girls are reporting high rates of sexual violence.

items.title: Ue, 'oggi nuove sanzioni per 5 persone coinvolte nel complesso militare russo'
items.description: 'Ogni nuovo attacco a Kiev è un motivo in più per alzare la pressione su Mosca'

items.title: Why was Taiwan’s president evacuated in the middle of the night?
items.description: President William Lai took part in an emergency evacuation drill as part of Taiwan military exercises preparing for a potential Chinese invasion.

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Warnings of famine and collapse as South Sudan's peace deal frays
items.description: Nearly eight million people in South Sudan – more than half the population – face crisis-level hunger, with famine risk now flagged in four counties, as the Security Council met this morning in New York. A cholera outbreak has killed more than 1,700 people, and some aid workers are being killed and abducted even as the…

items.title: ‘There were many of them, and the grass was tall’: 505 nights under Russian fire
items.description: Many soldiers in Ukraine are spending long periods on the front lines, as Ukraine struggles against Russia’s numerical advantage. One infantryman, in the trenches for nearly a year and a half straight, tells us his story.

items.title: Can ‘Russia’s Amazon’ Survive Ukraine’s Drone Campaign?
items.description: Russia’s online retail sector has thrived since the invasion of Ukraine. The attacks on Wildberries now threaten to disrupt that growth.

items.title: US Senator Rick Scott: Putin 'Underestimated Trump's Commitment To Freedom'
items.description: In an interview with RFE/RL, Republican Senator Rick Scott said Russian President Vladimir Putin did not anticipate the strength of US support for Ukraine's war effort, adding that a new sanctions bill is meant to hold Russia accountable.
